story.title: From the High Knuckles Ranges to the Royal Archives
story.p1: Born into a lineage of tea planters and Ayurvedic botanists in the shadow of the Knuckles Mountain Range, my childhood was charted not by street maps, but by the monsoon winds and the migration corridors of the Sri Lankan leopard. What began as instinctive village exploration evolved into formal scholarly discipline.
story.p2: In my early twenties, I apprenticed under senior conservators at the Sigiriya Cultural Triangle Project and the ancient ruins of Polonnaruwa. Under the shade of monastic brickwork, I learned to read ancient Brahmi script etched upon wet cave stone and decipher hydrological engineering feats designed three centuries before the Common Era.
story.p3: Later, while managing biodiversity programming for the island's most celebrated heritage retreats, I recognized a quiet longing among the world's most cultured voyagers: they did not seek generic tour commentaries rehearsed through megaphones. They sought thoughtful kinship, complete logistical ease, unhurried contemplation, and the unfiltered truth of our complex, radiant island.
story.quote: “Sri Lanka cannot be understood through a tour bus window. It reveals its heartbeat when you linger at a monastery at dawn, break fresh cinnamon bark between your fingers, and sit with a village elder over woodfire claypot curry.”
story.p4: Today, through Serendiva, I accept no more than sixteen bespoke private expeditions annually. Each guest is afforded my full personal presence, whether that means securing after-hours silence in the Inner Sanctum of Kandy's Temple or charting a safe navigation through Yala's deepest scrubland trails.

pillars.title: The Four Pillars of Private Hospitality
pillars.intro: Bespoke travel is governed by unspoken principles. Here is how your time and presence are safeguarded under my wing.

integrity.title: Uncompromised Integrity
integrity.body: Absolute zero commercial kickbacks or pressured stops at generic gem shops and spice stalls. Every artisan, boutique weaver, and estate visited is selected purely for historical authenticity.

pacing.title: Fluid Pacing & Autonomy
pacing.body: No hurried whistle-blowing or rigid checklists. Sleep late when weary, linger longer at an ancient cliff sanctuary, or pull over unexpectedly for fresh golden king coconuts from a village harvester.

safety.title: Safety & Discreet Discretion
safety.body: Advanced defensive chauffeur licensing, Red Cross emergency medical credentials, and seasoned discretion trusted by international ambassadors, executives, and high-profile creative families.

fluency.title: Biogeographic Fluency
fluency.body: Translating 2,500 years of Anuradhapura lithic records alongside deep field knowledge of wet-zone endemic orchids, butterfly corridors, and birding ecology.
